name: vms_bank_vsh1_rg4wg1_1015-vsh1-COMMIT
purpose: Valid-select successor of CLOSED hfd_vms_bank_ft_rg4wg1 (native pin audit FAIL: capture wslot 286/310 ps, wslot_v 219/300 ps -- the write one-hot decode sat in front of 8 pin-edge flops each fanning out to 276 AND gates on all four faces, so they were placed at the block centre far from the corner slot pins). Each write leaf is now masked by its OWN pin-captured valid (same face/edge as its payload, local fan-out); wslot/wslot_v feed only plain pin flops into the small write-enable/fault cone. No added edge (read n+6 / commit n+3 / egress n+1), same 3 SRAMs, pin ABI and balanced clock spine; a valid compiler schedule writes identical data; a schedule conflict faults and suppresses the write. | B kit (A/B with vms_bank_vs_rg4wg1_1015): light HB1 pin hold pad on inputs and outputs instead of HB2 -- the ft rg4wg1 view also missed the native budget on plain pin flops (wq0 37 pins <=197.9, pq 25 <=201.2, kq <=194 capture; rr1[25] launch 224.4) by the pad delay plus early pin-flop clocks; FF hold of the pins must still close in the route (ft FF +22.82).
